TIL: Cuban punks injected themselves with AIDS-infected blood in exchange for a short, free life

TL;DR: So in the '80s, people didn't know much about the AIDS virus. A group of Cuban punk rockers called "Los Frikis" chose to inject themselves with AIDS in order to live out the rest of their lives in a sanitarium. There, they were free to listen to whatever music they wanted, eat hard-to-find foods, and enjoy other perks that the rest of Cuban society couldn't experience. This was all because the sanitariums were run by progressive doctors who understood that there was no cure for the virus, so why not let the people live the way they wanted. The Cuban government did not want the virus to spread rampantly, so they ensured that all AIDS patients were removed from society and placed in quarantine. Some of the people who injected themselves were under the illusion that Cuba's doctors (who have a great reputation around the world) would quickly and easily find a cure.

There is a link to the Radiolab podcast episode "Los Frikis" in the article. It is a fantastic piece that is far more interesting than I made it sound.
